verdict: Maybe, with the right source. Aquapeya from Sangli pitched natural mineral water on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Natural mineral water sells at a premium, but needs a genuine natural source and BIS certification, and water is heavy to ship.
angle: Premium hotels, restaurants and health-conscious buyers pay more for natural mineral water. BIS certification is mandatory, and you need a protected spring or natural source. Freight costs mean it works best close to your source.
